written.headline: Nvidia's startup stakes reach $65.5B as interim CEO signals caution
written.summary: Nvidia revealed its equity stakes in private companies reached $65.5 billion, up from $22 billion in January. However, venture capitalists anticipate a pullback in startup funding following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang and a shift in tone under interim CEO Colette Kress.

written.headline: Stored AI user preferences can silently remove decision-critical details
written.summary: A research paper by Joshua Adrian Cahyono examines how AI memory of stored user preferences causes models to silently omit decision-critical information. Testing five models across 100 everyday decision scenarios, the study found that certain models saved brevity preferences and missed critical items in the majority of their later answers.

written.headline: Nvidia expands manufacturing capacity with suppliers to meet AI demand
written.summary: Nvidia announced it is expanding global manufacturing capacity with supply chain partners including Amkor, Foxconn, and TSMC to support long-term demand for its AI platforms. The multiyear initiative spans billions of dollars in investments across advanced packaging, substrates, and optical engines through 2029.

written.headline: Google rolls out Gemini Tasks assistant for free in six markets
written.summary: Google is rolling out its agentic AI assistant Tasks, formerly known as Gemini Spark, for free in the US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, and India. Bundled with the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, the feature allows users to make calls, book appointments, compare products, and complete purchases.
